description: Read one order by `id` and return its full snapshot for NORMAL, FAST, or EXTEND order types. Use this as the source of truth before `tronsave_update_order`, `tronsave_sell_order_manual`, or `tronsave_cancel_order` to avoid acting on stale state. Requires a signature session and `mcp-session-id`. Read-only and idempotent.

id.description: Target order id (`MObjectId`) to inspect. Use this to confirm current status/price before update, sell, or cancel actions.

name: tronsave_get_order

apy.description: Annualized yield hint as returned by the API (see TronSave semantics).

isMatching.description: Whether this order matches the viewer/matching filter used in the query.

isOwner.description: Whether the list query’s viewer context treats this row as owned by `myAddress`.

receiver.description: Receiver wallet and related party info for the delegation leg.

address.description: TRON base58 address for this party.

remainAmount.description: Resource not yet consumed or remaining to fulfill.

resourceAmount.description: Original resource amount on the order.
